name: Piazza Duomo
address: Vicolo dell'Arco 12, Angolo Piazza Risorgimento 4, 12051, Alba
dinnerNote: Seasonal Things tasting menu (white truffle menu €290 plus truffle)

menus.name: Seasonal Things tasting menu
menus.note: Courses chosen day by day from the garden and the market; lunch or dinner; wine pairing €240, or €580 with the finest Barolos

menus.name: Alba white truffle menu
menus.note: In truffle season; the truffle is charged by the gram at the day's market price

alsoTry.name: À la carte at Piazza Duomo
alsoTry.note: Single dishes from the truffle menu at €40–50 each, before the truffle

bookingOpens: Online, using the form on the restaurant's booking page, for up to 6 guests. In October and November it's open Tuesday to Sunday lunch; the rest of the year mostly Wednesday to Saturday, with dinner from Tuesday in some months.
groups: Groups of more than 6 send a request from the booking page. There's also a kitchen table and private events.
